title: Actor Registry Entry
description: Schema for a registered actor in the system control plane. An actor is any intelligence (human or AI) that can produce, validate, or route work. The identity triple (actor_id, actor_type, harness_id) is the canonical identity used across provenance, validation, and routing surfaces.

actor_type.description: Whether the actor is a human, an AI intelligence, or a hybrid

harness_id.description: The harness/runtime through which this actor operates (e.g., 'claude-code', 'codex-cli')

binary.description: CLI binary name for runtime detection

verification_only.description: Whether this actor can only verify, not produce work

preferred_for.description: Workflow types this actor is preferred for

adapter_surface.description: Harness-specific capabilities this actor's adapter provides
